facebookresearch_benchmarl/benchmarl/exp.log_hparams: log hyperparameters to all configured loggers with automatic flattening for TensorBoard
facebookresearch_benchmarl/benchmarl/exp.log_collection: log collection step rewards and episode metrics from a TensorDict batch to all loggers
facebookresearch_benchmarl/benchmarl/exp.log_evaluation: log evaluation rollouts with episode rewards, video frames, and JSON metrics for marl-eval reporting
